source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: After an offensive rebound, what is the NBA shot clock reset to?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The shot clock is instead set to 14 following an offensive rebound.

funFacts.text: FIBA introduced the shorter offensive-rebound clock years before the NBA adopted it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: FIBA adopted this in 2014 and the NBA adopted in 2018

funFacts.text: A defender merely tipping the ball does not restart the clock if the offense keeps possession.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The shot clock does not reset if a defender makes short contact with the ball

funFacts.text: Missing the rim entirely on an airball also leaves the previous countdown running.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: or if a shot attempt misses the rim entirely and airballs

questions.prompt: Utah once rallied from 36 down against Denver. How big a deficit did Boston erase against Kobe's Lakers to steal Game 4 of the 2008 Finals?
questions.context: Boston Celtics · 2008 Finals Game 4 · Los Angeles
questions.note: 24 points. Boston stormed back in L.A. for a 97–91 win and a 3–1 series lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers held their ground for most of the third quarter, leading by as many as 24 points.

funFacts.text: Boston ended the third quarter with a crushing run that turned the game around.
